story.summaryEn:
Up and running on the streets of Baku ⏱️ 
Max ends the opening frame in P2 👏
Isack's FP1 was cut short after losing drive early in the session. We're working to understand the problem ahead of FP2.
#F1 || #AzerbaijanGP 🇦🇿
